data-module="mediaTextSections" data-variant="alternating"><div class="tool-page__container"><article class="tool-page__media-text-row" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9"><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-copy"><h2>Create Anime from Text</h2><p>Describe a character, scene, or story in everyday language and see MiniMax Design turn it into anime concepts. Explore worlds, moods, outfits, compositions, lighting, and art styles with a single prompt—so you can move from a rough idea to a clear visual direction faster, with no drawing skills required.</p><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-action" data-seo-section-cta="true" data-tool-page-section-cta="true"><a href="#" class="tool-page__button tool-page__button--primary" data-download="auto">Convert Text to Anime</a></div></div><video aria-label="MiniMax Design creating anime concepts from a text prompt" class="tool-page__media-text-section-media" controls="" data-video-controls="immediate" data-video-src="https://file.cdn.minimax.io/minimax-hub-landing-page/ai-anime-generator-20260831-web-v2/feature-01-1080x1080.mp4" height="1080" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" poster="/assets/ai-anime-generator/covers/create-anime-from-text.png" preload="none" style="aspect-ratio:1080 / 1080" width="1080"></video></article><article class="tool-page__media-text-row" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9" data-reverse="true"><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-copy"><h2>Keep Characters Consistent</h2><p>Build characters your audience can recognize in every shot. Use character references to preserve facial features, hairstyles, outfits, colors, and signature details across poses, camera angles, and scenes. This workflow saves time, reduces rework, and gives every story-driven anime project a cohesive visual identity.</p><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-action" data-seo-section-cta="true" data-tool-page-section-cta="true"><a href="#" class="tool-page__button tool-page__button--primary" data-download="auto">Keep Characters Consistent</a></div></div><video aria-label="MiniMax Design keeping anime characters consistent across scenes" class="tool-page__media-text-section-media" controls="" data-video-controls="immediate" data-video-src="https://file.cdn.minimax.io/minimax-hub-landing-page/ai-anime-generator-20260831-web-v2/feature-02-1080x1080.mp4" height="1080" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" poster="https://cdn.hailuoai.video/minimax-hub-landing-page/seo-media/20260828/ai-anime-generator/posters/anime-feature-02-2a1c9eb6.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1080/format,webp" preload="none" style="aspect-ratio:1080 / 1080" width="1080"></video></article><article class="tool-page__media-text-row" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9"><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-copy"><h2>Build Anime Storyboards</h2><p>Turn a story, script, or rough outline into a clear sequence of anime shots. Plan characters, environments, actions, camera angles, pacing, and transitions before production—so your narrative is easier to review, your team stays aligned, and you can animate faster with fewer revisions and costly rework.</p><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-action" data-seo-section-cta="true" data-tool-page-section-cta="true"><a href="#" class="tool-page__button tool-page__button--primary" data-download="auto">Build Storyboards</a></div></div><video aria-label="MiniMax Design building anime storyboards and visual shots" class="tool-page__media-text-section-media" controls="" data-video-controls="immediate" data-video-src="https://file.cdn.minimax.io/minimax-hub-landing-page/ai-anime-generator-20260831-web-v2/feature-03-1080x1080.mp4" height="1080" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" poster="https://cdn.hailuoai.video/minimax-hub-landing-page/seo-media/20260828/ai-anime-generator/posters/anime-feature-03-2aecf240.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1080/format,webp" preload="none" style="aspect-ratio:1080 / 1080" width="1080"></video></article><article class="tool-page__media-text-row" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9" data-reverse="true"><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-copy"><h2>Bring Anime to Life</h2><p>Transform still anime artwork into fluid, cinematic motion without losing its original look. Direct character actions, facial expressions, camera motion, scene progression, and timing—then shape each shot with precision for more expressive performances, stronger storytelling, and polished anime videos.</p><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-action" data-seo-section-cta="true" data-tool-page-section-cta="true"><a href="#" class="tool-page__button tool-page__button--primary" data-download="auto">Animate Your Art</a></div></div><video aria-label="MiniMax Design bringing anime artwork to life with motion" class="tool-page__media-text-section-media" controls="" data-video-controls="immediate" data-video-src="https://file.cdn.minimax.io/minimax-hub-landing-page/ai-anime-generator-20260831-web-v2/feature-04-1080x1080.mp4" height="1080" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" poster="/assets/ai-anime-generator/covers/bring-anime-to-life.png" preload="none" style="aspect-ratio:1080 / 1080" width="1080"></video></article><article class="tool-page__media-text-row" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9"><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-copy"><h2>Control with Omni Reference</h2><p>Guide every anime scene with the references that fit your vision. Use images to lock in character identity and style, video to guide motion, camera movement, and framing, and audio to guide voices and sound—giving you more predictable results, greater creative control, and fewer generation attempts from prompt to final shot.</p><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-action" data-seo-section-cta="true" data-tool-page-section-cta="true"><a href="#" class="tool-page__button tool-page__button--primary" data-download="auto">Try Omni Reference</a></div></div><video aria-label="MiniMax Design controlling anime scenes with Omni Reference" class="tool-page__media-text-section-media" controls="" data-video-controls="immediate" data-video-src="https://file.cdn.minimax.io/minimax-hub-landing-page/ai-anime-generator-20260831-web-v2/feature-05-1080x1080.mp4" height="1080" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" poster="/assets/ai-anime-generator/covers/omni-reference.png" preload="none" style="aspect-ratio:1080 / 1080" width="1080"></video></article><article class="tool-page__media-text-row" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9" data-reverse="true"><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-copy"><h2>Create Anime with Visuals &amp; Audio</h2><p>Bring characters, scenes, dialogue, ambience, sound effects, and music together in one place. MiniMax Design coordinates assets across the production process, helping you create a richer atmosphere, stronger emotional beats, and cohesive anime projects faster—without switching between disconnected tools.</p><div class="tool-page__media-text-section-action" data-seo-section-cta="true" data-tool-page-section-cta="true"><a href="#" class="tool-page__button tool-page__button--primary" data-download="auto">Add Sound to Anime</a></div></div><video aria-label="MiniMax Design combining anime visuals and audio in one workflow" class="tool-page__media-text-section-media" controls="" data-video-controls="immediate" data-video-src="https://file.cdn.minimax.io/minimax-hub-landing-page/ai-anime-generator-20260831-web-v2/feature-06-1080x1080.mp4" height="1080" loop="" muted="" playsinline="" poster="https://cdn.hailuoai.video/minimax-hub-landing-page/seo-media/20260828/ai-anime-generator/posters/anime-feature-06-2f65600b.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1080/format,webp" preload="none" style="aspect-ratio:1080 / 1080" width="1080"></video></article></div></section><section class="tool-page__video-tutorial-steps" data-active-step="start-with-prompt-or-reference" data-media-aspect-ratio="16:9" data-module="videoTutorialSteps" data-variant="steps-with-media" id="video-tutorial"><div class="tool-page__container"><div class="tool-page__section-head"><h2>How to Create AI Anime with MiniMax Design</h2></div><div class="tool-page__video-tutorial-layout"><ol class="tool-page__video-tutorial-steps-list" aria-label="How to Create AI Anime with MiniMax Design"><li><button aria-controls="video-tutorial-media" aria-pressed="true" class="tool-page__video-tutorial-step" type="button"><span class="tool-page__video-tutorial-number">1</span><span class="tool-page__video-tutorial-copy"><strong>Start with a Prompt or Reference</strong><span>Describe a character, scene, or story with a prompt, image, or reference video. class="tool-page__section-head"><h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2></div><div class="tool-page__faq-list"><details><summary>What is an AI anime generator?</summary><p>An AI anime generator turns text, images, and other references into anime characters, scenes, storyboards, and videos. MiniMax Design brings these steps together in one creative workspace, so you can develop an anime idea from concept to animation.</p></details><details><summary>How do I create an animation?</summary><p>Choose how you want to start: enter a prompt, upload an image, or use a reference video with Omni Reference. MiniMax Design helps turn your idea into a polished animation.</p></details><details><summary>How do I keep the same character consistent across multiple scenes?</summary><p>Use a consistent character reference or Omni Reference throughout your project. MiniMax Design helps preserve key details such as the face, hairstyle, outfit, and colors across different poses, camera angles, and scenes.</p></details><details><summary>Can I make an animated GIF from an image?</summary><p>Yes. Upload an image, describe how you want it to move, and MiniMax Design will turn it into a short looping animation. Export the result, then convert it to a GIF if needed.</p></details><details><summary>What anime styles can I create?</summary><p>Create anime in manga-inspired, cel-shaded, chibi, retro, watercolor, and cinematic 3D styles. Add references to guide the colors, linework, lighting, and overall look.</p></details><details><summary>Do I need drawing, animation, or editing skills?</summary><p>No. Start with a simple prompt or reference, and MiniMax Design helps manage the complex production steps. You can refine the results whenever you want more creative control.</p></details><details><summary>What makes a good AI anime prompt?</summary><p>Describe the character’s appearance, setting, action, camera angle, lighting, mood, and anime style. For more consistent results, reuse the same character and style references across scenes.</p></details><details><summary>Can I edit my generated anime videos?</summary><p>Yes. Use the <a class="tool-page__heading-link" href="/tools/video-editor">AI Video Editor</a> in MiniMax Design to arrange anime clips, refine dialogue captions, and add transitions before exporting your finished sequence.</p></details></div></div></section></main><footer class="footer"><div class="page-content-frame footer__inner"><div class="footer__main"><div class="footer__brand"><div
